facts.statement: SOE supported the Child's Play charity with special in-game items purchasable with Station Cash, selected during December 21 to December 31.
facts.quote: Por cada articulo seleccionado dentro del juego del 21 de Diciembre al 31 de Diciembre, SOE donara $10 a la beneficencia, hasta $50, 000 en total.

facts.statement: SOE ran a Child's Play charity drive in which buying special Child's Play items in participating SOE games, including Free Realms, donates money to Child's Play.
facts.quote: SOE will donate $10 per item, up to a maximum of $50,000.

facts.statement: The special Child's Play items were only available during the month of December.
facts.quote: These very special items will only be available in the month of December

article_summaries.title: Child's Play 2010!
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post about the Child's Play 2010 charity drive. Between December 21 and December 31 (2010), Station Cash items sold in Free Realms earned a donation from SOE of $10 per selected item, up to $50,000 total. The Free Realms item in the drive was a penguin pet; the post lists one item per participating SOE game.

article_summaries.title: The SOE Child's Play Charity Drive
article_summaries.summary: SOE's holiday news post (German-localized page) announces the Child's Play charity drive, in which purchases of special items in participating SOE games, including the Free Realms pet Snowflake, trigger a $10 donation per item up to $50,000. The article says these items were available only in December. The page gives only a relative posting age ('3 months, 2 weeks ago'), so no absolute date is stated.
